description: This file implements AES ECB encryption functions for Nordic Semiconductor hardware, including blocking and non-blocking modes, interrupt handling, and a unit test.

methods.name: do_ecb
methods.description: Performs AES ECB encryption by triggering hardware, waiting for completion or error, and handling the process.

methods.name: ecb_encrypt_be
methods.description: Encrypts data in big-endian format using AES ECB.

methods.name: ecb_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data in little-endian format, with optional output in both formats.

methods.name: ecb_encrypt_nonblocking
methods.description: Starts non-blocking AES ECB encryption using hardware, enabling interrupts.

methods.name: ecb_cleanup
methods.description: Stops hardware encryption and disables related interrupts.

methods.name: isr_ecb
methods.description: Interrupt service routine handling AES ECB completion or error events.

methods.name: ecb_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of non-blocking encryption, updates context with status and cipher text.

methods.name: ecb_ut
methods.description: Unit test function for AES ECB encryption, verifying correctness.
